quote: A person shall not leave open a door on the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic longer than is necessary for immediate loading or unloading of passengers or cargo.

activation.condition: Door on the side closest to passing traffic is open.

obligation.description: Do not leave it open longer than necessary for immediate passenger or cargo loading or unloading.

timing.description: Measure original open, activity, inactivity and closing intervals without choosing a legal duration.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Review original passing body path, vehicle heading, door side and source geometry.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: longer than is necessary for immediate loading or unloading
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review original active/inactive passenger or cargo motion and open interval; necessity and immediacy remain unresolved.

parameter_refs.name: open_activity
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: active through open interval or active then inactive
